annotations.title: Look up a tax or filing rule

description: Looks up an HMRC or Companies House rule or rate by its words or its fact id (such as "annual investment allowance", "marginal relief", "accounts due 9 months" or corporation-tax-main-rate-fy2026) and answers each match with its figure or words, the tax year or financial year it applies to, and the gov.uk page that states it: the page's title, link, the words quoted from it and the date it was read. Use this when the person asks what a rate, allowance, threshold or deadline is, or where a figure in a derived return comes from. Give the rule with its source and quote it; do not advise on the person's own case, and send them to HMRC or Companies House for that. It needs no DIYA-GL book and does not contact an outside service.

query.description: A fact id, or the words of the rule or rate, such as annual investment allowance

name: look_up_rule
